ticker: Three workers die at Tata iPhone factory
Gold falls nearly 3% after hot CPI
Portugal braces for incoming Storm Charles

articles.headline: Three workers die at Tata iPhone parts factory
articles.brief: Three workers have died at a Tata Electronics iPhone components facility in India following a severe safety incident. Authorities and company officials are investigating the operational failures that led to the fatal accident.

articles.headline: IBM to end visa sponsorship for most consulting roles
articles.brief: Tech giant IBM is reportedly ending green card and visa sponsorships for the vast majority of positions within its global consulting division, impacting foreign professionals across numerous regional offices.

articles.headline: Microsoft surpasses Nvidia in global market capitalization
articles.brief: Microsoft has reclaimed the top spot over Nvidia in total market valuation for the first time since June 2025, driven by shifting investor sentiment across artificial intelligence and cloud computing infrastructure.

articles.headline: Gold plunges nearly 3% following hot CPI figures
articles.brief: Precious metals dropped sharply as higher-than-forecasted consumer price index data boosted the US dollar and Treasury yields, dampening immediate investor demand for non-yielding bullion assets.

articles.headline: Portugal braces for Storm Charles with school closures
articles.brief: Portuguese authorities have ordered school closures and mobilized emergency rescue personnel as the nation prepares for the arrival of severe weather system Storm Charles, bringing heavy winds and floods.

articles.headline: India proposes 3-part framework to de-escalate Ukraine war
articles.brief: India has formally introduced a comprehensive three-part diplomatic strategy aimed at facilitating de-escalation and restarting peace talks between Russia and Ukraine, emphasizing dialogue and humanitarian aid.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh clears massive investments in AI and tech
articles.brief: The Andhra Pradesh cabinet has approved strategic policy frameworks to attract large-scale capital investments into artificial intelligence, electronics manufacturing, and renewable energy, including a massive green data centre project.

articles.headline: US baby food and formula prices surge to record highs
articles.brief: American families are facing unprecedented financial strain after baby food and formula prices experienced their largest single-month surge on record, compounding everyday cost-of-living challenges.

articles.headline: GLP-1 weight loss drugs linked to rare vision loss risks
articles.brief: Medical researchers have flagged a potential connection between popular GLP-1 receptor agonist weight-loss medications like Ozempic and severe ischemic optic neuropathy, prompting calls for closer patient monitoring.

articles.headline: Jannik Sinner plans late-December return at exhibition
articles.brief: Top tennis star Jannik Sinner intends to return to competitive action at a Saudi exhibition tournament later this month, marking his first appearance since recovering from a persistent knee injury.

articles.headline: Formula One confirms standard 2026 calendar ending in Qatar
articles.brief: Formula One organizers have reaffirmed that the current championship season will conclude in Qatar and Abu Dhabi as originally scheduled, following unanimous support from all competing constructor teams.

articles.headline: Google Cloud integrates Meta AI models into managed APIs
articles.brief: Google has expanded its cloud capabilities by integrating Meta's latest artificial intelligence models into its managed APIs, allowing enterprise customers to utilize advanced tools for software development and workflow automation.

articles.headline: MEA strongly condemns US court summons to former RAW chief
articles.brief: India's Ministry of External Affairs has dismissed recent US court summons directed at former intelligence officials as frivolous and legally baseless, rejecting allegations regarding foreign assassination plots.

articles.headline: Jim Jordan elected House Republican leader following setbacks
articles.brief: US House Republicans have chosen Jim Jordan to lead their legislative caucus following the party's recent midterm election results, setting the stage for renewed policy clashes in Congress.
